added: You can use the Advanced panel while searching ContraDB online: groups of figure conditions (all of, any of, none of) and Sequence (then) rows find dances by the figures they contain, alone or together with the text you typed. A query with something ContraDB cannot run, such as a tag, tells you so instead of searching with it left out.
changed: A Sequence (then) row now finds a move that comes directly after the first one, the way ContraDB does, instead of any move that comes later in the dance. The dance counts as a loop, so the first move comes right after the last one.

added: Add translateDanceFilterToContraDb and buildContraDbFilterBody to build ContraDB filter expressions from an Advanced search tree.
changed: ThenFilter now matches a figure that immediately follows another, wrapping from the last figure to the first, instead of any later figure.
